name: PathWise
shortDescription: Diagnostic assessment and explainable adaptive learning paths.
features: Skills graph with prerequisites and question-to-skill mapping
Diagnostics, formative checks, practice sets and post-tests
Transparent weighted-evidence mastery model (not ML) with uncertainty
Recommendations with plain-language rationale and machine-readable evidence
Pre/post comparison separating participation from proficiency
knownLimitations: No psychometric/IRT model is claimed — rules-based mastery only
Short-response rubrics are manual-review notes in this MVP
